title: Start a system service
summary: Start a background service (like a printer or network daemon) that is currently stopped. This change is temporary and will not persist after a reboot.

steps.explain: Starts the specified system service immediately.

placeholders.name: UNIT
placeholders.description: The name of the service or unit to start (e.g., 'cups', 'nginx')

steps.expect: The command returns without error if the service starts successfully.

warnings: Starting a service requires administrator privileges.
This change is temporary; the service will not start automatically after a reboot unless it is also enabled.

rollback.explain: Stop the service to undo the start action.
